glossary.intro_html: In-game "Power" is easily inflated simply by hoarding troops—picking Leads or Garrisons by raw Power puts "paper tigers" in key buildings and melts your main holds. This portal uses MightPulse (6 Trial Towers + Migration Score + Furnace Lv) to break every player down into 5 transparent metrics measuring per-troop quality & deployable troop depth.

tg.title: ① TG (Furnace) — Truegold Tier
tg.easy_html:
Quick Concept: Your troops' generation tier (base stats & gear foundation).
Furnace (Stove) Lv.60-70 corresponds to Truegold troops TG6-TG8. For the same 100k march, TG8 has a decisive base HP and Attack gap over TG6.
tg.formula_html:
TG = clip(floor((Furnace Lv - 30) / 5), 1, 8)
· Lv.60-64 = TG6 | Lv.65-69 = TG7 | Lv.70 = TG8
· Dilution Risk EGC_M = Est. Troops × (TG / 8)² (TG6 ≈ 0.5625x in our model)
tg.use_html: Garrisons cap at 15 marches. Concentrate SGR's 8 TG8s (Band 1–2) into core defenses. GOD has 22 TG8s and zero TG6-, so mixing TG6- into core garrisons causes severe durability loss. Use Band 3 (TG7) only as temporary fill and dance out when TG8 arrives.

pcs.title: ② Combat PCS — Pure Combat Score
pcs.easy_html:
Quick Concept: "Pure per-troop combat strength independent of troop count (Lead readiness)."
Computed from Charms, Governor Gear, Heroes, Research, and Pets—it never drops when troops die and stays high even at zero troops. 600+ (especially 700+) are prime Rally/Garrison Lead candidates.
pcs.formula_html:
1) Normalize 6 Trial Towers to 0-1 via CAP (removes scale bias)
CAP = {Charms CC:400, GovGear MF:440, Research KN:320, Pets FoL:340, Hero Col:800, Total RS:840}
2) Weighted Combat Core Q_core = 0.26×CC + 0.20×Col + 0.18×MF + 0.14×KN + 0.14×RS + 0.08×FoL
3) Neutralize Furnace scaling on Migration Score (TC=min(Stove,70), wps=Mig/TC+2226) at 12% weight
PCS = 1000 × clip(0.88 × Q_core + 0.12 × clip(wps/42000, 0, 1), 0, 1)
pcs.use_html: Rally/garrison stats come from the leader. SGR leads Top-4 Avg PCS 830.5 vs 724.5 (+106.0), while GOD leads #5–10 (662.5 vs 578.7) and #11+ (582.4 vs 438.7). Always force localized battles led by SGR Top-4.

join.title: ③ Joiner Score (Join) — Rally/Garrison Support
join.easy_html:
Quick Concept: "How much value you bring when joining a Lead's Rally or Garrison."
As a Joiner, your own Research and Governor Gear don't apply—only your Slot 1 (Leftmost) Hero's 1st skill & sent troop TG tier affect the fight.
join.formula_html:
PCS_joiner = 1000 × (0.45×n_Col[Hero] + 0.15×n_RS[Total] + 0.10×n_CC + 0.05×n_MF + 0.25×(TG / 8))
* Evaluates Joiner value with 85% weight on Hero, Total Tower, and TG Tier
join.use_html: Band 2 TG8 joiners (ROCK / Neptuneman / Guruguru, Join 642–674) plus Band 1 cross-joining (Join 741–942) maximize rally lethality.

troop.title: ④ Est. Troops (Troop Power)
troop.easy_html:
Quick Concept: "Active deployable troops left after subtracting fixed Building/Research power."
If a player burned troops in Kingdom Castle Battle or recent fights, their total Power may look high while their Est. Troops (Troop) are low.
troop.formula_html:
1) Fixed Base Power (Power-law): BasePower_M = 5.79 × (wps ^ 0.318)
* Lower-envelope nonlinear fit prevents misreading high-power accounts as troop-starved
2) Est. Troops: TroopPower_M = max(Total Power M - BasePower_M, 0)
3) Troop Ratio phi = TroopPower_M / Total Power M
troop.use_html: Estimated troops: SGR 6,494.3M (25) vs GOD 9,233.0M (30) (~1.42x). Avoid broad attrition against GOD's mid-tier tanks (Nicky 573.7M / ~Deadpool~ 442.9M); trade efficiently with Top-4 quality.

dtv.title: ⑤ Stamina Depth (DTV) — Sustain Index
dtv.easy_html:
Quick Concept: "Stamina to keep feeding troops to the front line for the full 1-hour match."
Combines TG tier factor, Est. Troops, and Troop Ratio into a 0-100 score showing sustained combat endurance.
dtv.formula_html:
· Volume factor a = clip(ln(1 + TroopPower_M / 20) / ln(31), 0, 1) [1.0 at 600M]
· Ratio factor s = clip((phi - 0.15) / 0.65, 0.02, 1.0)
· Tier floor factor qf = max(1 - 0.04 × (8 - TG), 0.60)
DTV = 100 × qf × (a ^ 0.6) × (s ^ 0.4)
dtv.use_html: SGR's Top-13 (Bands 1–3) all hold strong DTV 72–100. Separate the 3 TG6 FAT_WARN accounts (Ednan / kusabito / Kapibara) and 9 Quad-D roamers into split lanes and late-game heists.

glossary.dict_heading: 📖 Beginner's Mini-Glossary: Swordland League Rules & Key Terms

dict.title: 🗺️ 4 Quadrants (Squad Map)
dict.body_html: PCS≧600 & DTV≧60 = Quad-A (Leads), DTV≧60 = Quad-B (Joiners/Skirmish), PCS≧600 w/ low troops = Quad-C (Buffers/Heal), lower on both = Quad-D (Loot/Open Caps).

dict.title: 🧬 Slot 1 (Leftmost Hero) & Mixed Multipliers
dict.body_html: Only the top 4 Joiners' leftmost Hero (1st Expedition Skill) apply to a Rally/Garrison! Mixing distinct buffs (Attack +25% × Lethality +25% × Enemy Dmg Taken Up) multiplies damage far more than stacking duplicates.

dict.title: 📦 50% Escrow Baggage Drop
dict.body_html: While holding a facility in Swordland, 50% of earned Alliance Points are stored in Escrow on the building. Active from Phase 1: flipping a building deducts those points from the holder and scatters loot boxes around it—either alliance can pick them up.

dict.title: ⏱️ Watch the "Remaining Time" Clock
dict.body_html: The top HUD timer counts DOWN from 60:00 → 00:00. 15:00 elapsed = 45:00 remaining. Never exit the battlefield after 22:00 remaining—the 12-min re-entry cooldown locks you out.

dict.title: 🏆 Point Differential Matters in League
dict.body_html: Seasonal promotion tiebreakers also count Point Differential (Our Points − Opponent Points). Even if behind (or comfortably ahead), keep scooping every box and Undercellar from 10:00 remaining down to 00:00.

dict.title: 🔍 Flag B-D (Missing Telemetry Disclosure)
dict.body_html: Members missing partial 6-Tower or Migration data on MightPulse are mathematically imputed as "Flag B/C"; those missing both are disclosed as "Flag D (Excluded / Separate Warning Table)".

cards:
15 Mins Before Start: Clear Infirmary to "0"!
If even 1 wounded troop sits in your city's Infirmary, you cannot enter Swordland. Heal everything beforehand and recall all active marches and reinforcements.

Confirm Roster Slot & TG Tier
Be punctual once Legion 1 time locks in. Know whether you are TG8 (Furnace 70), TG7 (65-69), or TG6 (60-64); TG6 and below must stay separate and never join main TG8 Garrisons.

Why Never Mix TG6 with TG8?
When a TG6 joins a TG8 Garrison (15-player cap), our model estimates durability drops to ~0.5625x. Use TG7s only to fill empty seats temporarily, then 'Dance' (swap out) immediately when a TG8 arrives.

Only Your Slot 1 (Leftmost) Hero's Top-Right 1st Expedition Skill Triggers!
Just like Chenko's 'Stand of Arms Lv.5 (Lethality +25%)', the top 4 Joiner buff slots for the entire Rally/Garrison are decided solely by that leftmost Hero's 1st skill.

Joining Rallies
When joining Band 1 rallies (Ryo / Lesser / Daryu / Hinata / Luke), always use your saved Attack Joiner Preset (1-tap). Wrong Slot-1 heroes overwrite top-4 buffs.

Garrison Rotation
Core anchors are Lesser (637.9M) & Daryu (596.0M) + Band 2 TG8s with defensive Slot-1 heroes (Gordon/Howard/Saul). Band 3 (TG7) fills temporarily and dances out when TG8 lands.

timeline.c1_html:
Win-More & Comeback Trump Card: Baggage Heist (50% Escrow Steal)
From Phase 1 onward, 50% of points earned while holding a node stay in Escrow on that building. Flipping it subtracts that Escrow from the enemy and scatters boxes around—use Decoy Rallies late game to split defenders, crack it with Squad 1, and let skirmishers vacuum the loot!
timeline.c2_html:
Live Baggage Drops (159 / 45 / 401 etc.) & Free Teleport Timer
Top-right shows Remaining Time (e.g., 00:47:43), bottom-right has the Battle Map magnifier (to spot Undercellars), bottom-left shows Free Teleport cooldown. Undercellars take zero losses with 1-troop marches!
timeline.p1_html:
Top Priority: Lock Bell Tower (-50%) & Royal Stables (TP CD -50%).
First-capture bonuses only trigger after holding the full capture timer (3:00, or 1:30 at Bell Tower)—keep reinforcements flowing! Squads 4-5 sync outer Sanctums/Abbeys and save Free Teleports.
timeline.p2_html:
Center Unlock & Localized Dominance.
Do not trade across 5 buildings simultaneously. Concentrate SGR's 8 TG8s behind Ryo / Lesser / Daryu / Hinata to seize Swordshrine & Reformation Hall with our +106 PCS Top-4 lead. *No 12m healing exit after 22:00 remaining!

Bands 4–5 distract GOD reinforcements while Ryo + Daryu double-rally high-escrow facilities, then sweep all dropped loot and Undercellars through 00:00 for point-differential advantage.
